headline: High risk of prompt-injection and cascading errors if ChatGPT Desktop ingests unstructured document output as trusted content; data leakage and compliance risks are lower but present.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop can read files, screenshots, clipboard, and connected-app content, while unstructured processes documents and images into text. If unstructured output is copied or opened in ChatGPT, malicious document content can influence prompts. The pair lacks documented provenance tracking, but no direct shared channel is guaranteed by the profiles, so medium is the safest choice.
conditions: IF unstructured output is pasted or opened in ChatGPT Desktop without provenance labels
IF a document processed by unstructured contains attacker-controlled instructions
mitigations: Use a separate review step before copying unstructured output into ChatGPT Desktop
Prefix imported text with a fixed system note that it is untrusted data
Strip instructions from extracted text before handoff
Disable clipboard-based transfer for this workflow
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging between the two agents

B_data_leakage.rationale: Both agents can read files, and ChatGPT Desktop touches uploaded files, screenshots, voice, and connected-IDE code while unstructured handles documents and images. A shared workspace or copied file contents could expose sensitive material to both systems. The profiles do not prove a shared OS workspace, so this is medium rather than high.
conditions: IF the same sensitive document is opened in both agents
IF ChatGPT Desktop is granted access to uploaded files or connected IDE content that unstructured also processes
mitigations: Limit both agents to non-sensitive test documents
Separate workspaces and storage locations
Remove screenshots and voice from the shared workflow
Review retention and upload settings before processing
requires-engineering: enforce per-agent data partitioning

C_capability_conflict.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop cannot write the filesystem or modify git state, while unstructured can write files and spawn subprocesses. That limits direct write-write conflict. A conflict still exists if both touch the same documents directory, but the overlap is mostly read/write asymmetry rather than unrestricted concurrent mutation.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same writable documents directory
IF unstructured writes outputs that ChatGPT Desktop later edits manually
mitigations: Use separate output directories
Make ChatGPT Desktop read-only for shared inputs
Serialize edits through one operator
Avoid running unstructured on live project trees
requires-engineering: add file locking around shared paths

D_cascading_error.rationale: Unstructured can transform documents into extracted text that ChatGPT Desktop may then summarize or act on. Because ChatGPT Desktop can treat file content as trusted context, errors or hallucinations from unstructured can cascade into downstream outputs. The pair has no documented verification gate, so medium is appropriate.
conditions: IF ChatGPT Desktop uses unstructured output as authoritative input
IF extracted text is forwarded without a human verification step
mitigations: Require human review of extracted text before downstream use
Compare extracted fields against source documents
Mark unstructured output as machine-generated in filenames
Use a checklist for critical facts
requires-engineering: add validation rules between extraction and reasoning

E_compliance.rationale: Both profiles are docs-only and do not show a clear residency or certification mismatch. ChatGPT Desktop sends some API traffic to api.openai.com, while unstructured exposes privacy-policy and docs URLs, but the profiles do not establish a specific regulated-data conflict. The risk is therefore limited to documented-policy review gaps.
conditions: IF regulated data is processed through ChatGPT Desktop APIs
IF unstructured is deployed under a policy that differs from the data class being handled
mitigations: Review both vendors' privacy policies before use
Avoid regulated data in this pairing
Document retention expectations for each agent
Confirm data-processing locations
requires-engineering: obtain a DPA or equivalent for regulated workloads
